title: The End of Book I

beats.name: Chains and the Key
beats.words: The door is shut, and the chains rattle; there is a grinding of the key in the lock…
beats.prompt: BK1IV-E Chains and Key, close view of the great castle door from inside in near darkness, heavy iron chains being drawn across it, a huge old key turning in a massive lock, a hand withdrawing it, cold grey light through a crack, oil painting, 1893, rich academic realism, dramatic chiaroscuro, film still --ar 16:9 --sref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ch04-e-slam-0.jpg --no faces, abstract, modern

beats.name: Those Awful Women
beats.words: I am alone in the castle with those awful women… They are devils of the Pit!
beats.prompt: BK1IV-E The Three Shadows, cinematic shot of a moonlit castle corridor, the long shadows of three slender women in flowing gowns cast across the stone floor and wall, the women themselves unseen beyond the frame, pale mist at floor level, cold blue moonlight through a tall window, oil painting, 1893, rich academic realism, dramatic chiaroscuro, film still --ar 16:9 --sref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ch04-e-slam-0.jpg --no faces, visible women, blood, nudity, abstract

beats.name: Good-bye, All! Mina!
beats.words: At its foot a man may sleep—as a man. Good-bye, all! Mina!
beats.note: The last image of Book I.
